findings.summary: THREE-AGENCY PIPELINE OPERATIONAL: DOJ shares voter roll data obtained from states with DHS. DHS repurposes SAVE (Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements) database — originally for immigration status checks of benefit applicants — to verify voter registration. Heather Honey (DHS election integrity, former FAIR Elections Fund VP) initially denied DHS was using DOJ voter data on Sept 11, 2025, but DHS contradicted her same day, confirming data would fuel SAVE system. DHS published Federal Register SORN expanding SAVE to add voter registration/verification as official purpose. Complete pipeline: (1) SSA/DOGE provides identity data -> (2) DOJ Voting Section (staffed by PILF alumni) collects voter rolls from states via confidential MOUs -> (3) DOJ shares rolls with DHS -> DHS cross-references against SAVE immigration database -> DOJ orders states to purge flagged voters within 45 days. All three nodes trace funding to CPI/DonorsTrust/Bradley dark money network.

findings.summary: DOJ VOTER ROLL PURGE OPERATION: DOJ sent confidential MOU to 12+ states requiring them to hand over full voter registration databases (including SSN and driver's license numbers), submit to DOJ analysis, and remove any voters DOJ flags as ineligible within 45 days. At least 12 states provided voter rolls: Alaska, Arkansas, Indiana, Kansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, Ohio, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Wyoming. Alaska and Texas signed the MOU. This is the DOJ operational output of the pipeline: PILF alumni staff DOJ Voting Section -> DOJ demands voter rolls from states -> DOJ flags voters for removal -> states must purge within 45 days. The Brennan Center warns this may violate the National Voter Registration Act which requires specific processes for voter removal.

THREE-PHASE FRAUD-TO-ELECTION ENFORCEMENT ESCALATION (Nov 2025-Mar 2026): Phase 1 (Nov 24): DOGE dissolved — data infrastructure, embedded CIOs, voter data pipeline remain. Phase 2 (Jan 8): NFED created with WH reporting line, nationwide fraud jurisdiction, McDonald (WWG co-chair) nominated to lead. Jan 16: DOJ acknowledges DOGE data misconduct. Jan 25: Bondi demands MN voter rolls alongside ICE operation. Phase 3 (Mar 16): Task Force to Eliminate Fraud EO — Vance chairs, targets CA/IL/NY/ME/CO (all Biden states), mandates federal-state data sharing. CONVERGENCE: The voter data pipeline DOGE built (SSA→DHS→SAVE→states) now has TWO parallel enforcement structures (NFED for prosecution, Task Force for investigation) both supervised by WH. PIN (election crimes) gutted to 2-5 lawyers. NFED does not list election fraud in charter but has jurisdiction over 'fraud affecting federal programs' which could encompass voter registration in federally funded systems.
